text:
sophia: Quick sync on a different angle: slot-reserve protocol (soft-reserve -> hard-reclaim) to reduce compaction spikes. Thoughts?
marco: Love the idea. Soft-reserve = batcher marks freed slots as "reserved" and issues opaque credit token. Scheduler redeems token to admit work.
anya: Need to define token semantics: immutable, single-use, TTL, and ledger persisted in batcher. Suggest TTL=250ms default.
ben: Also add a `decay` mode: a loan token that slowly decays amount over time to avoid hoarding if scheduler stalls. Keeps safety net.
sophia: Nice. That reduces risk of lost tokens causing overcommit. Batcher should emit token.{issued,redeemed,expired} metrics.
marco: Protocol sketch (plain text): GET /batcher/heartbeat -> {lane, occupancy, head_gap_ms, compactness_level}; POST /batcher/shaping -> quick; POST /batcher/reserve -> {lane, lease_id, target} -> {job_id}; POST /batcher/reserve/ack -> {job_id} -> {credits_token, freed:int, hold_ms} ; POST /scheduler/credits/redeem -> {credits_token, amount} -> {redeemed:true}
anya: Important: idempotency_key on reserve so retries return same job_id. Also add ownership_version to detect lane transfers.
ben: For auction-style fairness between multiple schedulers, reserve should include a small priority hint. Batcher can order pending reclaim jobs by priority to avoid head-of-line contention.
sophia: Observability: track credits.latency (ack->redeem), token_loss_rate, reserve.success_ratio. Add dashboard.
marco: Rollout plan: (1) expose heartbeat + shaping behind FF in canary, (2) implement reserve API in lab only, (3) enable reserve as opt-in for a few tenants, (4) full enable if tails improve.
anya: Perf tests: bursty small requests, simulate lost tokens, simulate cross-host ownership moves mid-reserve. Measure p50/p95/p99 and token-redemption latency.
ben: Edge cases: partial reclaim (batcher returns freed<int> < target). Scheduler must accept partial credits and adjust admission. Also cancel endpoint: POST /batcher/reserve/cancel?job=...&lease_id=... -> {cancelled, freed_partial}.
sophia: Action items: sophia -> write short RFC with token semantics + failure modes; marco -> proto stubs; anya -> telemetry and perf scenarios; ben -> fairness ordering sketch. I'll post RFC tomorrow and ping reviewers. :thumbsup:
